caption: Sukanya Samriddhi pays 8.2% a year, tax-free, for your daughter's future. Rs 1,000 a month grows to about Rs 5.5 lakh in 21 years. Open it before she turns 10. Save this for later, and follow Rupee Sense for the next money basic.
